_comment: DRAFT, NOT SUBMITTED. Mode readout_ab_d3: an EVAL-ONLY run of the SAVED D3 checkpoint (job-93fpy, d3_v2f_gold: LoRA r64 + cache-fork head trained on the v2f template) on the 2,008-row Index DEV subset under several readouts in ONE process (jobs.m2_first_cell.readout_ab: one model load, one lineage check, one temperature fit): v2f = the training template (matched control) and v3w = the R3 winner on the stock parent (job-fgu2c 31.07, +1.97 [+0.17, +3.80] vs v2f). Add "v3p" to readouts for the secondary (+~62 min, +~$3.05 billed; the readout_ab cap 215 already fits three: 15 + 3 x 61.2 x ratio = 199 <= 0.95 x 215). Phases setup 25 / guard 5 / checkpoint 15 / readout_ab 215 / report 10 / reserve 7 = 277. Expected (two readouts at D1's measured 32.8 child rows/min): 15 fixed + 61.2 + 61.4 = 138 scoring min, ~158 run min = $7.80 billed ($0.0495), + build ~15 min = $8.54; worst case (60 + 2 x 277) x 0.0495 = $30.39. d1_fast's flags (row_plan, cont_plan, compile_blocks) are training-step execution flags (act_ckpt block body / step row grouping): scoring never runs them, so they do not apply. Parent arm (stock families, readout_ab_parent_arm true + phase_caps_minutes.parent_ab 55 and +55 to max_duration_minutes) is optional: job-fgu2c already measured the stock parent under every readout.
